# Replace the starter favicon and site icons

Replace `src/favicon.ico` with a favicon appropriate for the new theme. Add other icon sizes or formats only if needed by the design; do not leave template branding in the browser tab.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The favicon is recognizable at small sizes and legible in light and dark browser chrome.
- [ ] Icon references in `MainLayout.razor` point to assets that exist and resolve through the theme URL helper, including under a subpath base URL.
- [ ] Any additional icon files are included in the theme assets and their usage is documented where necessary.
